title: Cultural Value Differences of LLMs: Prompt, Language, and Model Size

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to Hofstede's Value Survey Module (VSM) 2013 questionnaire to quantify the expression of cultural values across six distinct dimensions, and comparing these outputs to human survey data.

Comparing the cultural values expressed by models when prompted with identical VSM 2013 survey questions in different languages (specifically English versus Chinese) to see if the querying language alters the model's cultural alignment.

Providing the models with simulated background identities that vary by nationality, age, and gender, to measure whether changing the demographic context alters the cultural values expressed in the models' responses.
Assessing the robustness of the models' answers by shuffling the order of multiple-choice options in the VSM questionnaire to test for token and position bias.
